purpose: Teach: チューナー/チェックポイント/オペレーター/コントローラー/ビデオテープ/サイコロ/バーナー/ホーン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の電波チューナーの感度を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check the sensitivity on the lab radio tuner.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Authority without harshness. Opens with the name like calling attention. Task-focused, expectation of competence. No warmth needed, only clarity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験プロセスのチェックポイントを増やします
lines.en: Yes. I'll add more checkpoints to the experimental process.
lines.style: Quick, attentive response. Eager to show understanding. Slight rush in the delivery — trying to prove he's tracking. Not defensive, just genuinely trying to get it right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、コールセンター運営のオペレーター心理の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the paper on operator psychology in call center management.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Direct assignment. Name first, task second. Assumes he'll do it. No preamble, no softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置のコントローラー操作研修を受けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll take the training module for experimental equipment control operation.
lines.style: Immediate compliance. Slightly formal register — 'training module' and 'operation' sound rehearsed. He's confirming he understands the assignment, not questioning it. Small pause after 'Yes' to signal he's processing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、古い研究映像のビデオテープを保存しろ
lines.en: Ren — save those old research video tapes. They're archival.
lines.style: Same economical tone. Slightly slower on 'archival' — emphasizing why this matters. Not a throw-away task. Still clipped, but the brevity carries weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サイコロを使う確率実験を再現します
lines.en: Yes. I'll set up the probability experiment with dice.
lines.style: Rapid acknowledgment. He's understood and moving to action. No hesitation. Clean, efficient delivery — he's locked in to the workflow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験用バーナーの炎の安定を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — verify the flame stability on the experimental burner.
lines.style: Clipped, final. Same no-nonsense register. Opens with his name. Safety-critical task implied by the phrasing. Brief, expectant. This is what he's there for.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。フィールド調査でホーンを携行します
lines.en: Yes. I'll carry the horn for the field survey.
lines.style: Final compliance. Quickest response yet — he's learned the pattern. Efficient, almost reflex. Still respectful but economical. Slight sense of wrapping up.
